name: Nix Hashes neu berechnen
command: for package in unwrapped server; do NP_LOCATION=/tmp/t3-nix-home /tmp/nix-portable nix build --impure --no-link --print-build-logs --expr "let flake = builtins.getFlake \"git+file:///workspace/t3code-pi\"; in flake.packages.x86_64-linux.$package.pnpmDeps.overrideAttrs (_: { outputHash = \"sha256-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=\"; })" > "/tmp/t3-nix-$package.log" 2>&1; echo "$package exit=$?"; tail -20 "/tmp/t3-nix-$package.log"; done
